# Claude Code Plugins Plus Skills Vendor Catalog Record

Upstream project: `jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills`

Upstream URL: <https://github.com/jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills.git>

This directory preserves the MARK-58 marketplace catalog record for the
MARK-46 reference-pack pools. It records the upstream catalog surfaces and
their final outcomes without mirroring bundle payloads into installable
marketplace content.

## Scope

Catalog pools preserved here:

- `plugins/saas-packs` (106)
- `plugins/business-tools` (21)
- `plugins/community` (18)
- `plugins/crypto` (27)

The record is intentionally catalog-only. It does not activate these upstream
packs as marketplace defaults and does not mirror their bundle payloads.

## Provenance boundary

This record is not first-party Harley-owned doctrine. It preserves upstream
catalog outcomes with license and source provenance intact.
